ch.txt: How to claim your bonus? 1. Register on the website. 2. Open an account in any of the currencies available on the website. If you open a cryptocurrency account, you are eligible for a bonus of up to 600%. If you open an account in any other currency, you are eligible for a bonus of up to 500%.

lines.t: How to claim your bonus?
1. Register on the website.
2. Open an account in any of the currencies
available on the website. If you open a
cryptocurrency account, you are eligible for a
bonus of up to 600%. If you open an account in
any other currency, you are eligible for a bonus
of up to 500%.

ch.txt: 3. Visit the "Bonuses" section and familiarize yourself with all the terms in the available bonus card. 4. To activate the +600% bonus and 500 FS, top up your cryptocurrency account: - 130% and 70 free spins on your first deposit - 140% and 100 free spins on your second deposit - 160% and 150 free spins on your third deposit - 170% and 180 free spins on your fourth deposit 5. Or top up your account in any other currency to activate a +500% bonus and 500 FS: - 100% and 70 free spins on your first deposit - 120% and 100 free spins on your second deposit - 130% and 150 free spins on your third deposit - 150% and 180 free spins on your fourth deposit 6. Free spins become available after the percentage bonus has been used. Full bonus conditions are available on the bonus card in the "Bonuses" section.
